We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves. No hiding behind process or headcount. Our Values Bias to action: We move fast, ship hard, and don’t wait to be told. Optimistic about AI: We’re excited about a future with abundant intelligence and keep pushing to use AI in new ways. What You'll Do Own every recruiting channel: Run our AI recruiting partners, agencies, sourcing tools, referrals, and inbound as one funnel, so no role depends on a single source. Brief and calibrate partners: Translate each hiring manager’s bar into a clear target profile, give partners fast, specific feedback on every submission, and recalibrate when the shape is off. Judge submission quality: Read every profile against the real bar, not a scorecard. Know which partners are sending great people and which are sending volume, and act on it. Fill the gaps yourself: When a channel isn’t producing for a hard role, source directly and build the pipeline. Run the process: Screening, intro chats, scheduling, references, offer packets, and closing, with quick responses and honest declines. Own Ashby as a system: Pipelines, stages, AI screening criteria per role, and reporting the team actually reads. Keep hiring managers moving: Run weekly syncs, write candidate notes that let them decide fast, and flag stalled loops before they cost us a candidate. Track what works: Time to hire, pass rates by stage, and source quality by partner. Use the numbers to fix the funnel and cut what isn’t working. Keep postings current: Draft job descriptions on our template and hand every hire cleanly to onboarding. What We're Looking For Technical recruiting experience: You’ve closed technical hires at a startup (backend, infrastructure, ML, or developer tools) and can talk to an engineer about what they build. Operational rigor: You run many roles at once without dropping candidates or partners. AI-native: You’re fluent in Ashby (or a comparable ATS) and use AI tools every day, from sourcing to screening to writing. Interview Process Application Review: Tell us about the hardest technical role you’ve closed: what the bar was, where the hire came from, and how you managed the channels that fed it.
